title: Fable 5.1 Cracked a 4 Year Old Bug Every Other Model Missed
description:
Fable 5.1 held a plan together for hours where other models fell apart by step 40. It disassembled a vendor library, matched it to a crash log, and found a bug that stumped engineers for four years, one that Opus 5, GPT 5.6, and the old Fable 5 all missed. Cache reads dropped 75%, agentic work costs up to 45% less. Tool or something else? 

#aitools #fable #claudecode #anthropic
